stories.title: Dharmendra died in Mumbai on 24 November, aged 89
stories.body: Padma Bhushan recipient, star of Sholay with 300+ films across six decades, and a former Lok Sabha MP.

one_liners: Dharmendra died in Mumbai on 24 November, aged 89 — Padma Bhushan recipient, star of Sholay with 300+ films across six decades, and a former Lok Sabha MP.
